paper.title: One Policy, Many Embodiments: Unified Camera-Centric Action Geometry Pre-training for Heterogeneous Embodied Manipulation

claim: UCAG-P 把操作表示为相机可观测的锚点运动而非本体专属控制：共享动作空间用语义锚点对在相机坐标系中的运动描述任务进度，使机器人臂、人形机械手和人手演示成为同一动作模式的不同 embodiment。

evidence.summary: Section 4.2 开篇定义共享空间 G：跨机器人臂、人形与人手演示，任务进度通过腕/末端与抓取中心在相机视野中的运动显现，这些量与 VLA 使用的视觉证据绑定而不与特定关节布局或控制器绑定。
evidence.short_quote: The shared space G describes manipulation through camera-observable geometry rather than embodiment- specific controls, as presented in Figure 5. Across robot arms, humanoid manipulators, and human demon- strations, task progress is visible through the motion of the acting wrist or end effector and the grasp center in the camera view.

paper.title: One Policy, Many Embodiments: Unified Camera-Centric Action Geometry Pre-training for Heterogeneous Embodied Manipulation

claim: 锚点语义跨本体固定：人类手部演示中 p0 取自腕部关键点、p1 取拇指尖与食指尖的中点；机器人 embodiment 中 p0 来自模拟器状态或正向运动学提供的腕/末端坐标系、p1 由夹爪或手部几何计算。

evidence.summary: Section 4.2 给出锚点对实例化：人类手部由 hand keypoints 提供锚点对；同段前文给出机器人 embodiment 的 p0/p0 计算来源（腕/末端坐标系、夹爪几何），锚点语义角色固定而物理实例随本体变化。
evidence.short_quote: For human-hand demonstrations, hand keypoints provide the corresponding anchor pair, with p 0 obtained from the wrist keypoint and p 1 defined as the midpoint between the thumb tip and index fingertip.

paper.title: One Policy, Many Embodiments: Unified Camera-Centric Action Geometry Pre-training for Heterogeneous Embodied Manipulation

claim: 输入侧的相机异构处理：所有 RGB 统一缩放到 224×224 并做轻量颜色增广；因相机数量因数据源而异，观测被打包进固定数量的视图槽（view slots），缺失视图零填充并用视图有效性指示符禁用。

evidence.summary: Section 3.2 Stage 2 描述视觉与语言标准化：统一分辨率 224×224、轻量颜色增广缩小仿真/真机/egoistic 演示的外观差距；相机数量差异通过固定视图槽与 view-validity indicators 处理。
evidence.locator: page 7, Section 3.2 Data Curation and Preprocessing, Stage 2
evidence.short_quote: Because camera counts differ across sources, observations are packed into a fixed number of view slots. Missing views are zero-filled and disabled by view-validity indicators.

core_citations.title: pi0.5: a vision-language-action model with open-world generalization
core_citations.reason: 真机与 LIBERO-Plus 的主要对比基线（引文 [43]），面包抓取 20% vs 60% 的对照锚点。

notes: 与鱼眼综述的接口：本文是'相机几何统一接口'机制层证据，不是鱼眼应用正面证据。关键判断：(1) 应用方式——腕装第一视角人类演示经 MediaPipe 关键点→相机坐标锚点运动进入统一 VLA 预训练（2.34K 小时、36.71% 语料），无需动作重定向；(2) 获益——egoistic 演示的 human-to-robot 迁移（真机 60% vs π0.5 20%）与单检查点跨本体统一（LIBERO 98.3%/RoboTwin 88.7-89.2%/GR-1 62.0%）；(3) 受限——相机偏移是七类扰动最弱项（51.2%），标定/深度/关键点误差传播为作者自认，ARX 直接换本体仅 35.0%；(4) 对鱼眼的推论边界——全文未用鱼眼/全景相机，鱼眼径向畸变下的锚点检测与相机坐标几何未被测试，本文只能作为'该路线对标定质量敏感'的旁证而非鱼眼直接证据。

paper_reading.relation: 支持机制层命题：多相机/环视类输入在统一策略中通过'固定视图槽+有效性掩码'机制接入——相机数量异构被显式建模，为多相机（含鱼眼阵列/环视套件）配置提供输入层兼容方案。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: page 7 Stage 2 逐字给出 view slots、zero-filled、view-validity indicators；224×224 与颜色增广出自同段前文 'All RGB observations are resized to a common resolution, 224 × 224 by default, and receive lightweight color augmentation'（已核对）；claim 仅复述输入侧机制，无性能断言。

topic: 近一年鱼眼镜头（含全景/环视/超广角相机）在具身智能领域的应用方式、效果与局限是什么？哪些任务获益、哪些受限？

paper.title: One Policy, Many Embodiments: Unified Camera-Centric Action Geometry Pre-training for Heterogeneous Embodied Manipulation

claim: 作者声明真机评估是刻意受控且规模有限的：实验支持 human-to-robot 迁移和数据高效 SFT 适配，但更广泛的真机鲁棒性需要跨更多机器人、相机设置、物体类别和长程任务的评估。

evidence.summary: Section 6 Limitations 第三条：real-world evaluation is intentionally controlled and limited in scale；附录 D（page 30）复述同一条并强调需评估更多相机设置。
evidence.short_quote: Our real-world evaluation is intentionally controlled and limited in scale. The experiments support human-to-robot transfer and data-efficient SFT adaptation, but broader real-world robustness requires evaluation across more robots, camera setups, object categories, and long-horizon tasks.
